purpose: Teach: 志願/裏切り/改悪/増幅/治癒/固執/埋葬/ファシズム

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員に過度な志願精神を強いるな
lines.en: I won't push our staff beyond their limits. We don't demand excessive sacrifice.
lines.style: Measured opening. Quiet authority without harshness. Each phrase lands deliberately. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone stating principle, not negotiating it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の裏切りに対しても対話を試みます
lines.en: Understood. When staff feel let down, we'll respond with conversation, not dismissal.
lines.style: Clear and attentive. Slight nod in the voice. Absorbing the directive carefully. Professional but not stiff—showing he's genuinely taking this in.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、制度改悪と取られぬ改革を進めろ
lines.en: Make sure our reforms look like progress, not backtracking. The way we implement this matters.
lines.style: Firm but not cold. A light emphasis on 'implement'—this is where intention meets reality. Steady pace. The voice of someone who understands optics and substance both matter.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。SNS増幅効果を活用したマーケティングをします
lines.en: Understood. We'll use social reach strategically—but in service of what actually helps people.
lines.style: Engaged and thoughtful. Slight pause before the second clause, showing he's connecting the dots. Not just taking orders—showing he understands the broader intent.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員のメンタル治癒を支援しろ
lines.en: Support our staff's wellbeing. That's non-negotiable. Make the systems actually work for them.
lines.style: Quieter intensity here. The word 'non-negotiable' carries weight without being loud. A slight lean forward in the voice. This is where his exacting nature shows—he means it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。過去の成功に固執しない方針です
lines.en: Yes. We'll make sure people have real agency—no rigid thinking, no top-down control.
lines.style: Affirmative but thoughtful. A slight hesitation before 'agency'—he's choosing his words carefully. Warm underneath the formality. He understands what's being asked here.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、廃棄物の埋葬を法令に従って処理しろ
lines.en: We'll handle waste disposal by the book. Complete compliance, no shortcuts.
lines.style: Direct and clipped. The practicality of someone moving through a checklist but not dismissively. Slight emphasis on 'by the book.' Professional but not distant.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内文化がファシズム的にならぬよう注意します
lines.en: Understood. We'll keep our workplace culture open and human—vigilant against any rigidity taking root.
lines.style: Serious closing note. Slight gravitas on 'vigilant'—he's absorbing the full weight of what's being asked. Quiet determination. The voice of someone who understands the stakes.
